headline: Colonials Retake Weathered Expanse Ground as Wardens Seal Callahan's Passage
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse has turned once more: where our last edition found the Wardens holding seven of nine posts, a Colonial rally has clawed back two, leaving four Warden against two Colonial and three grounds in ruin, with fifty-six actions logged in the day and the latest stroke filed at press time. Callahan's Passage, contested at our last writing, has gone wholly to the Wardens, all ten posts theirs after losses above eleven thousand apiece in twenty-four hours. Palantine Berm still seethes about The Droll, twenty-eight events there alone; the Wardens count five posts to one Colonial, one ground demolished, the freshest stroke likewise at press time. Stlican Shelf has slipped a post, seven Colonial to one Warden with one base in ruin, Briar again the busiest ground. The Nevish Line has registered no post changes since the evening, though Warden losses keep pace. Stonecradle and Kuura Strand see steady churn about The Reach and Martti; Callums Cape has gone quiet since the small hours. Elsewhere the 517th-day front lies largely untroubled, Linn of Mercy quiet despite heavy Warden losses; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
